name: Lakeside Steel Manufacturing Co
old_description: Lakeside Steel & Mfg. Co. has served the metal fabrication needs for the power generation industry, material handling, construction equipment, and original equipment manufacturers for over 100 years. We use our experience, creativity, imagination, and best manufacturing principles to make the impossible possible for our customers.
about:
Lakeside Steel & Mfg. Co. operates from Kenosha, Wisconsin, where it has provided metal fabrication services for more than a century. The company’s history spans over 100 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly documented. Ownership details and founder names have not been disclosed.

The shop runs a 41,000-square-foot fabrication facility supported by an 11,000-square-foot warehouse that stocks carbon and stainless steel sheet, plate, and structural shapes. In-house processes include CNC plasma and flame cutting, shearing, press braking, plate rolling, welding, and painting, while stress relieving, blast cleaning, galvanizing, machining, and non‑destructive testing are handled by qualified subcontractors. The plant is equipped with five overhead cranes (5–20 ton), eight jib cranes, a 600‑ton hydraulic press brake, plate rolls capable of 1‑inch thick plate, and 22 welding stations. Lakeside has produced single pieces as large as 13‑foot‑6‑inch diameter by 70‑foot long weighing over 105,000 pounds, and operates on multiple shifts to meet short lead times.

Primary markets are power generation, material handling, construction equipment, and original equipment manufacturers. Representative projects include combustors, air piping, coal ducts, trommels, inlet water pipes, forklift booms, shaker conveyors, fly ash silos, cement hoppers, explosion‑door components, galvanized platforms, and a variety of structural frames and enclosures.

Lakeside emphasizes its strategic location midway between Chicago and Milwaukee, which provides rapid highway and rail access for nationwide shipping. The company also highlights its on‑site steel inventory, multi‑shift staffing, and certified craftsmen as key factors that enable precise, timely delivery.
